exposure: counselling with an empowerment approach based on the GATHER model
cohort: The study included 80 primigravida mothers aged 18-40 years, whose hospitalized premature infants had a gestational age of 28-34 weeks.
finding: Counselling with an empowerment approach based on the GATHER model was effective in significantly reducing stress and increasing self-esteem in mothers of premature infants admitted to the intensive care unit.
